title: OSHA Log Summary (Form 300A)
description: OSHA Form 300A, the annual Summary of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses an establishment posts from its Form 300 log: the year covered, the establishment, the case counts by outcome, the day totals, the counts by injury and illness type, employment figures, and the certification.

form_number.description: The OSHA form number as printed, e.g. 300A.

form_revision.description: Revision date printed beside the form number, e.g. 01/2004, or null if absent.

year.description: Calendar year the summary covers, printed beside 'Year' at the top of the form.

name.description: Value written on the 'Your establishment name' line.

state.description: State of the establishment, as printed.

industry_description.description: Industry description written by the employer. Null if the line is blank. Do not return the printed example text '(e.g., Manufacture of motor truck trailers)'.

sic_code.description: Standard Industrial Classification code if filled in. Null if blank. Do not return the printed example 'SIC 3715'.

naics_code.description: North American Industrial Classification (NAICS) code if filled in. Null if blank. Do not return the printed example '336212'.

number_of_cases.description: The Number of Cases row, columns G through J.

days_away_from_work.description: Total number of cases with days away from work, column (H).

job_transfer_or_restriction.description: Total number of cases with job transfer or restriction, column (I).

other_recordable.description: Total number of other recordable cases, column (J).

number_of_days.description: The Number of Days row, columns K and L.

days_away_from_work.description: Total number of days away from work, column (K).

days_of_job_transfer_or_restriction.description: Total number of days of job transfer or restriction, column (L).

injury_and_illness_types.description: The Injury and Illness Types section, column (M).

annual_average_employees.description: Annual average number of employees, as a plain integer without separators.

total_hours_worked.description: Total hours worked by all employees last year, as a plain integer without separators.

is_signed.description: True if a signature appears on the Company executive line.

title.description: Title of the certifying executive, from the Title line.

phone.description: Phone number on the Phone line.

date.description: Date of certification from the Date line, as YYYY-MM-DD.
